meaning: Constrains results to listings owned by one specific user id.

invariants.label: Owner scope

invariants.label: Explicit only

text:
# filter.userId

TL;DR:
- filter.userId narrows search to listings owned by one user id.

What it means:
- It is an owner-scope filter for a known user, not a substitute for filter.my.

Agent hint:
- Prefer filter.my for current-actor ownership. Use filter.userId only for known external owner ids.
